records.title: How to Apply (TVO ILC)
records.summary: TVO ILC is an online high school for people at least 14 (or turning 14 by December 31 of the school year) who have completed Grade 8 and are not enrolled in an Ontario high school; current students go through their guidance counsellor. Choose courses, enter details, pay the $40 per course fee (partly subsidized for most Ontario residents, non-refundable), then upload proof of Ontario residency and citizenship and academic records. Homeschoolers first give their board a notice of intent and upload its reply letter.

records.title: Accessibility (TVO ILC)
records.summary: TVO's accessibility policy for goods and services (Ontario Regulation 191/11), plus tips for navigating the online courses, such as recommended browsers and operating-system tools for mouse customization, screen magnification and text-to-speech.
